adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff adds an unconditional refresh-token POST to `https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token` (and subsequent `prisma.credential.update`) before constructing the `jsforce.Connection`. Unlike other integrations updated in this PR, Salesforce does not use the new `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` helper, so when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` + `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set, Salesforce will still call Salesforce directly and never honor sync mode. The refresh is also performed unconditionally in this construction path (no expiry check shown), implying an extra network round-trip and DB write per instantiation/call site.
